def submission : Goal := by
  intro G _ h
  have step : ∀ a b c : G, (a ◇ b) ◇ a = c ◇ a := by
    intro a b c
    have h1 : ((c ◇ a) ◇ b) ◇ (c ◇ a) = a := (h a c b).symm
    have h2 : ((((c ◇ a) ◇ b) ◇ (c ◇ a)) ◇ b) ◇ (((c ◇ a) ◇ b) ◇ (c ◇ a)) = c ◇ a :=
      (h (c ◇ a) ((c ◇ a) ◇ b) b).symm
    rw [h1] at h2
    exact h2
  have leftConst : ∀ a b c : G, a ◇ c = b ◇ c := by
    intro a b c
    exact (step c c a).symm.trans (step c c b)
  have cancel : ∀ a b : G, a ◇ (a ◇ b) = b := by
    intro a b
    have h1 : ((a ◇ b) ◇ a) ◇ (a ◇ b) = b := (h b a a).symm
    have h2 : ((a ◇ b) ◇ a) ◇ (a ◇ b) = a ◇ (a ◇ b) := step (a ◇ b) a a
    exact h2.symm.trans h1
  have main : ∀ a b c : G, a ◇ (b ◇ c) = c := by
    intro a b c
    exact (leftConst a b (b ◇ c)).trans (cancel b c)
  intro x y z
  exact (main (y ◇ z) (x ◇ x) x).symm

def submission : Goal := by
  intro G _ h
  have rightAbsorb : ∀ a b : G, a ◇ b = b := by
    intro a b
    let P : G := a ◇ (a ◇ a)
    have hs : (P ◇ (P ◇ b)) ◇ a = a := by
      change ((a ◇ (a ◇ a)) ◇ ((a ◇ (a ◇ a)) ◇ b)) ◇ a = a
      exact (h a a ((a ◇ (a ◇ a)) ◇ b)).symm
    have ht : ((P ◇ (P ◇ b)) ◇ a) ◇ b = b := by
      exact (h b P a).symm
    rw [hs] at ht
    exact ht
  intro x y
  exact (rightAbsorb y x).symm

def submission : Goal := by

  have H : ∀ x y z : G, (((y ◇ x) ◇ x) ◇ z) ◇ x = x := by
    intro x y z

  have hL : ∀ a b : G, (a ◇ b) ◇ a = a := by
    intro a b
    calc
      (a ◇ b) ◇ a = (((((a ◇ a) ◇ a) ◇ a) ◇ a) ◇ b) ◇ a := by
        rw [H a a a]
      _ = a := by

    intro a b
    calc
      (a ◇ b) ◇ b = ((((a ◇ b) ◇ b) ◇ (a ◇ b)) ◇ b) := by
        rw [hL (a ◇ b) b]
      _ = b := by
        exact H b a (a ◇ b)
